# The committee for dry socks

The second toy chapter is here to show chapter ordering. Bookdown uses `_bookdown.yml`, while the source files use prefixes like `01-`, `02-`, and `03-` so humans and agents can keep the order straight.

The committee in this chapter has three rules:

- never store notebooks under a leaky ceiling
- never trust a spreadsheet without row counts
- never ask an agent to make every row match

The last rule matters. A better prompt is: merge accurately, report unmatched rows, and explain whether any defensible corrections are available.

For citations, this chapter points to another toy source [@author_notebooks_1902].
